name: StoryEngine Build Relay
description: Three agents work in relay: Orchestrator plans tasks, Backend builds endpoints, Frontend wires UI, QA verifies. Tab-by-tab until feature-complete.
icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 22 22' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5'><rect x='3' y='3' width='16' height='16' rx='2'/><path d='M7 8h8M7 11h8M7 14h5'/></svg>
agentDescription: Analyzes the pipeline, audits what exists vs what's missing, creates daily task lists, assigns work to Backend Dev, Frontend Dev, and QA Engineer.

skills.name: Audit Pipeline
skills.description: Read the full pipeline flow. For the current tab, map every status, field, action, and data flow. Identify what exists vs what's missing.

skills.name: Backend Build
skills.description: Build FastAPI routes, Pydantic models, database migrations. Ensure every pipeline action has a working endpoint that returns the right data shape.

skills.name: Frontend Wire
skills.description: Build React components, TypeScript types, API client calls. Wire every backend endpoint to a visible UI element with loading/error/empty states.

skills.name: QA Verify
skills.description: Run tsc --noEmit, curl every endpoint, check types match responses. Run Playwright to verify UI loads data. Pass or fail back to the responsible agent.

skills.name: Advance Tab
skills.description: When QA confirms 100% complete for current tab, mark it done and advance to the next tab in the pipeline sequence.

name: Video Production Pipeline
description: The core pipeline that StoryEngine manages: idea → research → script → voice → images → video → thumbnail → render → upload
icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 22 22' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5'><polygon points='9,3 19,11 9,19'/></svg>
agentDescription: The video production pipeline that StoryEngine orchestrates. Each stage has a status, data, and actions that need UI representation.

skills.name: Idea Logged
skills.description: Video idea created from competitor analysis or manual input. Fields: title, hook, thesis, source, DNA.

skills.name: Research
skills.description: Deep-dive research generates 14-field payload: thesis, fact sheet, historical parallels, character dossier, visual seeds.

skills.name: Script Generation
skills.description: 6-act script with scene blocks, validated by 7 editorial checks. Segments split into per-scene narration.

skills.name: Voice Synthesis
skills.description: ElevenLabs generates per-scene audio. Whisper transcription provides word-level timestamps for karaoke.

skills.name: Image Prompts
skills.description: 3-style system generates 120 cinematic prompts across 20 scenes. Storyboard grids for review.

skills.name: Image Generation
skills.description: Seed Dream 4.5 generates scene images. Approval queue for review. Variant generation for alternatives.

skills.name: Video Motion
skills.description: Veo 3.1 generates video clips from images. Ken Burns motion for static scenes.

skills.name: Thumbnail
skills.description: Gemini-directed thumbnail with template selection. Text overlay, subject extraction.

skills.name: Render
skills.description: Remotion renders final MP4: audio sync, karaoke captions, Ken Burns, crossfades, music bed.

skills.name: Upload
skills.description: YouTube upload as unlisted draft. SEO metadata, description, tags, show notes.

name: Autopilot Learning Loop
description: The autonomous intelligence cycle: scrape competitors → score candidates → generate ideas → launch videos → monitor CTR → extract learnings → improve next cycle. This is the brain of StoryEngine.
icon: <svg viewBox='0 0 22 22' width='22' height='22' fill='none' stroke='currentColor' stroke-width='1.5'><circle cx='11' cy='11' r='8'/><path d='M11 7v4l3 3'/><path d='M7 11a4 4 0 0 1 8 0' opacity='0.5'/></svg>
agentDescription: The autonomous decision engine. Every video is an experiment. Every CTR measurement is data. The system compounds learnings over time, making each cycle smarter than the last.

skills.name: Scrape Competitors
skills.description: yt-dlp scrapes all active competitor channels daily. Extracts: titles, views, VPH, thumbnails, transcripts (auto-captions). Saves to competitor_videos table. Background task: _auto_scrape_competitors() runs every 24h.

skills.name: Score Candidates
skills.description: Confidence scoring: VPH component (55% weight, log-scale: 100 VPH=37%, 1000=64%, 10K=85%) + Freshness component (45% weight, linear decay over 168h). Top candidates ranked for selection. Configurable weights and thresholds.

skills.name: Generate Ideas
skills.description: Claude Sonnet 4 generates 5 unique angles from top 15 competitors. Each idea gets 3 title options scored by predicted CTR. Master Formula rules enforced. Previous learnings injected: proven patterns boosted, anti-patterns avoided.

skills.name: Launch Video
skills.description: User selects an idea + title option. System creates video record, marks candidate as modeled, and triggers the full 10-stage production pipeline automatically.

skills.name: Sync YouTube Metrics
skills.description: YouTube Data API v3 + Analytics API v2 pull: views, CTR, impressions, retention, watch time, subscriber gain. Snapshot milestones at 24h, 48h, 7d, 30d. Background task: _auto_sync_youtube() runs every 6h.

skills.name: Extract Learnings
skills.description: 4 pattern detectors scan published videos (CTR + 1000+ impressions): title patterns (10 types), hook patterns (4 types), script patterns (7 types), framework patterns. Verdict: CTR >= 5% = KEEP, CTR <= 3% = DISCARD. Weighted averages update confidence over time.

skills.name: Analyze Competitor Patterns
skills.description: Structural analysis of competitor titles and transcripts. Detects winning patterns (question format, numbers, caps emphasis, urgency hooks, story hooks). Saved to title_insights table. Injected into next idea generation cycle.

skills.name: Compound & Repeat
skills.description: Learnings from this cycle feed into the next: proven patterns get higher confidence, anti-patterns get avoided, new hypotheses get tested. Every video makes the system smarter. The loop never stops.
